verdict.rationale: Convex documents ACID, fully transactional mutations and optional schemas that enforce data shape, with TypeScript queries running in the database and backed by indexes. The evidence never shows relational joins or relational constraints such as foreign keys or uniqueness, and the no-SQL, document-table model only covers part of the relational story. missing for 10: documented join support, relational/integrity constraints (foreign keys, unique), independent hands-on corroboration of relational querying.
